sense: a small room, as in a prison

terms.comment: Any small room: a store-room, a porter’s lodge, a slave’s room, a poor man’s garret (Lewis & Short). Varro derives it, rightly, from cēlāre, to hide (LL 5.162).

terms.gloss: a little room, a small cell
evidence: Ter. Eun. 309: in cellulam ad tē patris penum omnem congerēbam
terms.comment: Levi–Bini’s solitary confinement is sēgregātiō in cellulā.

phrases.latin: Nam mē jam in cellam aliquam cum illā conclūdam: id tūtissimum est.
phrases.english: I’ll shut myself up with her in some little room right now: that’s safest.
